summary: Verified end-to-end fix for Delete User button in Super Admin panel. Both backend DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id} and frontend SuperAdminPanel delete handler work correctly. No ReferenceError detected; optimistic UI removal, success toast, and persistence after reload all confirmed. Self-delete properly returns server-side 'Cannot delete your own account' error.

test_cases_executed.case: UI: navigate /app/super-admin?tab=users as superadmin, click delete on resident 'أحمد محمد'
test_cases_executed.result: PASS - confirm dialog accepted, row removed, count 16->15

test_cases_executed.case: UI: success toast 'تم حذف المستخدم' displayed
UI: after page reload deletion persists (count=15, row absent)
UI: delete-self attempt shows 'Cannot delete your own account' toast, row remains
Console: no ReferenceError / 'fetchUsers is not defined' after delete
Other Super Admin tabs load (overview, codes, coupons, ads)

critical_code_review_comments: SuperAdminPanel.js is ~1900+ lines and should be split into smaller feature files (Users tab, Codes, Coupons, Ads, Campaigns) for maintainability.

Delete handler inlined as an async arrow directly in JSX (line 475-486) — fine for the fix, but consider extracting to a named handleDeleteUser(userId) to match other handlers (handleDeleteCode, handleDeleteCoupon, handleDeleteAd) for consistency.

After delete, both optimistic setUsers and fetchDashboard() are called — fetchDashboard re-fetches users and dashboard; either keep optimistic-only (and refresh stats via a smaller call) or drop optimistic to avoid duplicate re-renders.

admin_users.py DELETE endpoint does not enforce compound isolation (super_admin can delete anyone, which is correct; but require_admin path does not scope to current_user.compound_id — acceptable only because require_admin here permits super_admin).

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 passed, 1 skipped - create-user flow requires compound setup)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing users. Deleted resident 'أحمد محمد' (id b247809c-f3f9-4861-bf2a-d192fcabbdb3) as part of the test (real deletion, compound_count 16->15).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delete user fix is confirmed working. Note: routes under /app/super-admin (NOT /super-admin). Frontend localStorage token key is 'token' but login API returns 'access_token'. User test deleted 1 resident, so current super-admin user count is 15 (not 16).
rca of the issue: Root cause confirmed: previous handleDelete called fetchUsers() (undefined), throwing ReferenceError caught by try/catch showing failure toast even though DELETE request succeeded. Fix (renamed to fetchDashboard + optimistic setUsers filter + console.error logging + data-testid) verified to resolve the issue end-to-end. No regression detected in other Super Admin tabs.
